plugins.name: Lua Support
plugins.author: Lithe Community
plugins.description: Lua code intelligence through your installed lua-language-server, plus running the current file with lua. Requires lua and lua-language-server (brew install lua lua-language-server).

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 通过本机安装的 lua-language-server 提供 Lua 代码智能，并用 lua 运行当前文件。需要先安装 lua 和 lua-language-server（brew install lua lua-language-server）。
